title: Ingest Decision Hub and Contract Shadowing for Usage Events
creator: Priya Narayanan
description:
Problem: The current usage event pipeline rejects or silently coerces a non-trivial portion of incoming events without a clear signal to customers or product teams. We need a non-disruptive path to (1) make ingestion decisions central and policy-driven, and (2) shadow alternate contract interpretations to collect evidence about schema drift before enforcing them.

Goal: Build an Ingest Decision Hub (IDH) that centralizes accept/reject/soft-accept rules, exposes a shadowing mode that records how events would be processed under new contract rules, and streams shadow outcomes to a dedicated evaluation topic for offline analysis. The IDH will support feature flags for canarying rules to a percentage of tenants, and will emit structured telemetry for every decision.

Scope:
- Routing layer between API edge and existing ingest queue that calls the IDH.
- Rule registry (declarative YAML/JSON) with versioning and metadata.
- Shadow execution path that applies candidate rules but does not affect canonical routing; outcomes are written to eval topic.
- Observability hooks: decision traces (trace id, rule ids, execution time), per-tenant rejection rate, shadow-vs-real divergence metrics.
- Backward-compatible onramp; default behavior set to current pass/fail until opt-in.

Non-goals: Full schema auto-rewrite, long-term storage of all shadow payloads beyond 30 days.

Acceptance criteria:
- IDH responds under 5ms P95 for rule lookups in production traffic patterns.
- Shadow messages for 100% of canary traffic appear in eval topic within 3 seconds of ingestion.
- New metrics surface in Console (per-tenant rejection_rate, shadow_divergence) and dashboards are published.
- No customer-visible increase in error rate during gradual rollout to 10% of traffic.

Rollout plan:
1) Dev: unit + integration tests, local rule registry simulator.
2) Staging: run IDH in passive mode for 24h against realtime replay.
3) Canary: enable IDH decisioning (soft-accept) for 10% of requests for two weeks, collect divergence signals.
4) Gradual enforcement only after product sign-off and low divergence.

Monitoring & Alerts:
- P95 latency > 10ms for rule lookup -> paged SRE.
- Shadow divergence spike > 2x baseline -> notify product and data-infra.
- Rejection rate per-tenant increases > 0.5% from baseline -> auto rollback and investigation.

Migration notes:
- Provide migration script to auto-register current validation rules as a rule bundle with metadata.
- Add SDK helpers in ingestion clients to opt into canary traffic.

Security & compliance: IDH will read KMS-wrapped tenant metadata; ensure role-based access for rule registry changes. Security review required before canary.
